title: Uruguayan-Style Beef Tacos
description: A flavorful and tender beef dish inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, served in crispy tacos.

ingredients.name: Nutty Uruguayan Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Blend of thyme, oregano, and rosemary

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the ground beef with Nutty Uruguayan Seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Cook the beef in the grill, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks, until it reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Transfer the cooked beef to a bowl and stir in diced onion and minced garlic.
Warm the tacos according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto a warmed taco and squeezing a sliver of lime juice on top.
